arxiv-2302-09091.title: Neutrino-Assisted Early Dark Energy is a Natural Resolution of the Hubble Tension
arxiv-2302-09091.creator: Mariana Carrillo González, Qiuyue Liang, Jeremy Sakstein, Mark Trodden
arxiv-2302-09091.description: Abstract It has very recently been claimed de Souza and Rosenfeld 2023 that the neutrino-assisted early dark energy model — a promising resolution of the Hubble tension that can ameliorate the theoretical fine-tuning and coincidence problems that plague other theories — does not provide natural or cosmologically interesting results.

arxiv-2311-13755.title: Transformer-based Named Entity Recognition in Construction Supply Chain Risk Management in Australia
arxiv-2311-13755.creator: Milad Baghalzadeh Shishehgarkhaneh, Robert C. Moehler, Yihai Fang, Amer A. Hijazi, Hamed Aboutorab
arxiv-2311-13755.description: Abstract The construction industry in Australia is characterized by its intricate supply chains and vulnerability to myriad risks. As such, effective supply chain risk management (SCRM) becomes imperative. This paper employs different transformer models, and train for Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the context of Australian construction SCRM.

arxiv-2312-03003.title: MobileGPT: Augmenting LLM with Human-like App Memory for Mobile Task Automation Conference: The 30th Annual International Conference On Mobile Computing And Networking; Fall, 2024; Washington, D.C., USA Conference: The 30th Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking; November
arxiv-2312-03003.creator: Sunjae Lee, Junyoung Choi, Jungjae Lee, Munim Hasan Wasi, Hojun Choi, Steven Y. Ko, Sangeun Oh, Insik Shin
arxiv-2312-03003.description: Abstract . The advent of large language models (LLMs) has opened up new opportunities in the field of mobile task automation. Their superior language understanding and reasoning capabilities allow users to automate complex and repetitive tasks. However, due to the inherent unreliability and high operational cost of LLMs, their practical applicability is quite limited.

arxiv-2402-10775.title: Intermodulation spectroscopy and the nonlinear response of two-level systems in superconducting coplanar waveguide resonators
arxiv-2402-10775.creator: Janka Biznárová, J. C. Rivera Hernández, Daniel Forchheimer, Jonas Bylander, David B. Haviland, Gustav Andersson
arxiv-2402-10775.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Janka Biznárová, J. C. Rivera Hernández, Daniel Forchheimer, Jonas Bylander, David B. Haviland, Gustav Andersson. Two-level system (TLS) loss is typically limiting the coherence of superconducting quantum circuits. The loss induced by TLS defects is nonlinear, resulting in quality factors with a strong dependence on the circulating microwave power. We observe frequency mixing due to this nonlinearity by applying a two-tone drive to a coplanar waveguide resonator and measuring the intermodulation products using a multifrequency lock-in technique.

arxiv-2405-20380.title: Gradient Inversion of Federated Diffusion Models
arxiv-2405-20380.creator: Jiyue Huang, Chi Hong, Lydia Y. Chen, Stefanie Roos
arxiv-2405-20380.description: Abstract Diffusion models are becoming defector generative models, which generate exceptionally high-resolution image data. Training effective diffusion models require massive real data, which is privately owned by distributed parties. Each data party can collaboratively train diffusion models in a federated learning manner by sharing gradients instead of the raw data.

arxiv-2508-13773.title: PENGUIN: Enhancing Transformer with Periodic-Nested Group Attention for Long-term Time Series Forecasting CCS: Applied computing Forecasting CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks
arxiv-2508-13773.creator: Tian Sun, Yuqi Chen, Weiwei Sun
arxiv-2508-13773.description: Abstract . Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) is a fundamental task with wide-ranging applications. Although Transformer-based models have made significant breakthroughs in forecasting, their effectiveness for time series forecasting remains debatable. In this paper, we revisit the significance of self-attention and propose a simple yet effective mechanism, Periodic-Nested Group Attention, namely PENGUIN .

arxiv-2512-07276.title: Geo3DVQA: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for 3D Geospatial Reasoning from Aerial Imagery
arxiv-2512-07276.creator: Mai Tsujimoto, Junjue Wang, Weihao Xuan, Naoto Yokoya
arxiv-2512-07276.description: Abstract Three-dimensional geospatial analysis is critical for applications in urban planning, climate adaptation, and environmental assessment. Current methodologies depend on costly specialized sensors (e.g., LiDAR and multispectral), which restrict global accessibility. Existing sensor-based and rule-driven methods further struggle with tasks requiring the integration of multiple 3D cues, handling diverse queries, and providing interpretable reasoning.

arxiv-2601-03910.title: An Algebraic Representation Theorem for Linear GENEOs in Machine Learning
arxiv-2601-03910.creator: Francesco Conti, Patrizio Frosini, Nicola Quercioli
arxiv-2601-03910.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Francesco Conti, Patrizio Frosini, Nicola Quercioli. Geometric and Topological Deep Learning enhance machine learning by exploiting geometric and topological structures in data. In this context, Group Equivariant Non-Expansive Operators (GENEOs) provide a principled framework for encoding symmetries and designing efficient, interpretable neural architectures. Originally introduced in Topological Data Analysis and later adopted in Deep Learning, GENEOs unify geometric and topological approaches and include, as a special case, the operator computing persistence diagrams.

britannica-1911-taylor-john-pamphleteer.title: Taylor, John (pamphleteer) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-taylor-john-pamphleteer.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-taylor-john-pamphleteer.description: Article 'Taylor, John (pamphleteer)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the 24th of August 1580. After fulfilling his apprenticeship to a waterman, he served (1596) in Essex's fleet, and was present at Flores in 1597 and at the siege of Cadiz. On his return to England he became a Thames waterman, and was at one time collector of the perquisites exacted by the lieutenant of the Tower.

govdocs-archive_org-MasonicTempleToPadre.creator: Franco Adessa (with Fr. Luigi Villa)
govdocs-archive_org-MasonicTempleToPadre.description: Special edition of the Italian Catholic journal "Chiesa viva" (no. 381, March 2006) arguing that the new church dedicated to St. Padre Pio bears Masonic symbolism.

pmc-10586247.title: Nonuniform STM Contrast of Self-Assembled Tri-n-octyl-triazatriangulenium Tetrafluoroborate on HOPG
pmc-10586247.creator: Sergii Snegir, Yannick J Dappe, Dmytro Sysoiev, Thomas Huhn, Elke Scheer
pmc-10586247.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We have assembled 4,8,12-tri-n-octyl-4,8,12-triazatrianguleniumtetrafluoroborate (TATA-BF4) on highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG) and have studied the structure and tunneling properties of this self-assembled monolayer (SAM) using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) under ambient conditions. We show that the triazatriangulenium cations TATA+ form hexagonally packed structures driven by the interaction between the aromatic core and the HOPG lattice, as evidenced by density functional theory (DFT) modeling.

pmc-10625043.title: Analysis of the Breast Cancer Journey in Namibia
pmc-10625043.creator: Pauline Boucheron, Annelle Zietsman, Johanna Pontac, Rolf Hansen, Benjamin O. Anderson, Kayo Togawa, Peter M. Macharia, Milena Foerster, Joachim Schüz, Isabel dos-Santos-Silva, Valerie McCormack
pmc-10625043.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat are the priorities for strengthening the breast cancer (BC) journey in Namibia?FindingsIn this cohort study of 405 Namibian women with incident BC recruited at the main national public oncology center, Black women were disadvantaged all along their BC journey compared with their mixed ancestry and White counterparts.

pmc-11366585.title: The effects of exercise on microRNA expression profiling in adipose tissue macrophages of mice
pmc-11366585.creator: Fei Qin, Wenbai Huang, Chaoyi Qu, Lina Zhao, Yunyu Du, Tianyu Zhao, Yiwei Feng, Jiexiu Zhao
pmc-11366585.description: BackgroundExercise is recognized for its broad health benefits, influencing various physiological processes, including the behavior of adipose tissue macrophages (ATMs). While existing studies mainly associate ATM activity with obesity and metabolic syndrome, our study explores the impact of aerobic exercise on ATM microRNA expression profiling in a non-obese context, highlighting its general health-promoting mechanisms.

pmc-11496811.title: An in vitro evaluation of tensile strength of molar endocrown milled from various computer aided design and manufacturing materials
pmc-11496811.creator: Ahmed Ismail Taha, Aya Ehab Saad
pmc-11496811.description: New computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing (CAD-CAM) materials have been reported to have suitable mechanical and physical properties for endocrown restorations. However, there is a lack of literature on evaluating the retention of endocrown using these materials. This in vitro study aimed to compare the retention of endocrowns fabricated from 3 different CAD-CAM materials.

pmc-12618539.title: Weed control and environmental risk assessment of herbicides in a Brazilian Atlantic forest railway ecosystem
pmc-12618539.creator: Caio Antonio Carbonari, Plinio Saulo Simões, Renato Nunes Costa, Robinson Antonio Pitelli, Edivaldo Domingues Velini
pmc-12618539.description: Weeds along railway lines pose serious operational and environmental challenges, particularly in protected natural areas where vegetation management must balance efficacy and ecological safety. The objective of this study was to select herbicides that are effective in controlling weeds and to evaluate the associated environmental risks.

pmc-12698140.title: Prevalence and Impact of Violence Against Healthcare Workers in Brazilian Emergency Departments: A National Survey
pmc-12698140.creator: Julia M Dorn de Carvalho, Sarayna S McGuire, Lucas L R Oliveira, Fernanda Bellolio, Otávio T Ranzani, Bruno AM Pinheiro Besen, Helio Penna Guimarães, Maria Camila Lunardi, Aidan F Mullan, Ludhmila A Hajjar, Ian Ward A Maia
pmc-12698140.description: IntroductionWorkplace violence (WPV) is a significant occupational hazard in healthcare, with emergency departments (EDs) recognized as high-risk environments. Although globally significant, data from Latin America remain scarce. In this study we aimed to evaluate the prevalence and effects of WPV on healthcare workers in Brazilian EDs.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional survey of healthcare workers in Brazilian EDs.

pmc-12763862.title: Positive predictive value of Dutch Elder Abuse Scale (ERASE): an early warning tool for elder abuse in the emergency department and geriatric outpatient setting
pmc-12763862.creator: Miriam E Van Houten, Regina L M Van Boekel, Lilian C M Vloet, Marcel G M Olde Rikkert, Reinier Akkermans, Brigitte Van De Kerkhof-Van Bon, Kim E Jie, Jacinta A Lucke, Yvonne Schoon, Sivera A A Berben
pmc-12763862.description: BackgroundElder abuse (EA) is a worldwide problem with serious consequences for individuals and society. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of EA and positive predictive value (PPV) of the Dutch Elder Abuse Scale (ERASE), an early warning tool for EA in patients presenting to the emergency department (ED) or geriatric outpatient clinic (GOC) in hospitals in the Netherlands.

pmc-12975980.title: Case Report: Combined central and peripheral nerve demyelination with neurofilament heavy chain antibodies
pmc-12975980.creator: Xue-Lu Zhao, Ze-Yu Zhao, Chun-Lin Yang, Hua Xu, Min Zhang, Guan-Qing Wang, Ying Liu, Yan-Bin Li, Rui-Sheng Duan, Xiao-Li Li
pmc-12975980.description: Combined central and peripheral demyelination (CCPD) is a rare chronic demyelinating disorder. Neurofilament (NF) proteins are structural components specific to neuronal intermediate filaments within axons. The presence of anti-neurofilament antibodies is typically associated with axonal pathology and is seldom observed in patients with CCPD.

pmc-13154463.title: VExUS versus CVP for assessing venous congestion: oasis or mirage?
pmc-13154463.creator: Xiang Si, Daiyin Cao, Christopher Lai, Sheldon Magder, Xavier Monnet
pmc-13154463.description: Both venous excess ultrasound (VExUS) and central venous pressure (CVP) can assess venous congestion from different perspectives. CVP provides continuous and simple monitoring of the risk of congestion and is easily repeatable in patients with a central venous catheter. In contrast, VExUS offers an intermittent, organ-level evaluation of established congestion and may help identify the venous waterfall phenomenon.

pmc-13221462.title: Correction: ELF1-mediated transactivation of METTL3/YTHDF2 promotes nucleus pulposus cell senescence via m6A-dependent destabilization of E2F3 mRNA in intervertebral disc degeneration
pmc-13221462.creator: Xiao-Wei Liu, Hao-Wei Xu, Shu-Bao Zhang, Yu-Yang Yi, Sheng-Jie Chang, Shan-Jin Wang
pmc-13221462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). the Ythdf2 immunofluorescence image in Figure 8E was inadvertently misplaced during image assembly and upload, and the correct original image was not presented. The accurate Figure 8E has now been replaced, as shown in the Amended Figure 8. Furthermore, in Figure 8K, the molecular weight of YTHDF2 should be 62 kDa instead of 70 kDa, which we have modified in the Amended Figure 8. pmc-13355880.creator: Marij W Janjua, Immad Shah, Thomas G Wiedemann, Adnan Shah

pmc-13610552.title: Physical Processing Controls the Structure, Mesoporosity, and Suspension-Phase Functionality of Nanostructured MnOx Materials
pmc-13610552.creator: Ekaterina Saenko, Pavel Khramtsov, Igor Valtsifer, Anastasia Novokshonova, Viktor Valtsifer
pmc-13610552.description: Physical processing can modify the structural, textural, and dispersion characteristics of nanostructured oxide materials, thereby altering their functional state under suspension conditions. Here, poorly crystalline, sol–gel-derived porous MnOx materials were used to establish how post-synthetic physical processing affects the relationship between nanoscale structure, accessible mesoporosity, powder-to-suspension transfer, and chromogenic response in 3,3′,5,5′-tetramethylbenzidine (TMB) oxidation.

pmc-13632282.title: Dietary mimicry of melena following chocolate cookie ingestion in a patient with colostomy: a case report
pmc-13632282.creator: Clement P Buclin, Nils Bürgisser, Gabriele Lombardo, Roxane Naimi
pmc-13632282.description: BackgroundMelena is dark, tarry stools that typically indicate upper gastrointestinal bleeding. However, various dietary substances can alter stool color and potentially lead to diagnostic confusion. We present a rare case of stool discoloration caused by the ingestion of chocolate sandwich cookies.
